prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1395; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss for side impact collision at intersection. Insured reports other vehicle entered intersection against signal. Police report requested. Claimant reported knee injury at scene and was transported by EMS. Claimant now represented by counsel; all contact to go through attorney's office.

Entry 2: Spoke with attorney's office regarding representation letter. Confirmed claimant's medical treatment is ongoing for knee injury. Requested itemized medical bills, treatment records, and wage loss documentation. Advised that property damage to claimant's vehicle is being handled separately. Reviewed scene photos submitted by insured, which show damage to driver's side door and rear quarter panel.

Entry 3: Obtained police report. Responding officer noted conflicting statements at scene but cited other driver for failure to yield. Witness statement secured from pedestrian at corner, consistent with insured's account. Liability position under review pending final investigation.

Entry 4: Received medical records from treating orthopedic provider. Records indicate knee injury involving soft tissue damage, with physical therapy recommended. Follow-up with attorney's office scheduled to discuss treatment timeline. No independent medical examination requested at this time.

Entry 5: Reviewed file with supervisor. Liability assessed as probable for other driver, subject to receipt of final recorded statement. Attorney's office notified that claim evaluation will proceed after medical treatment reaches maximum improvement. Diary set for follow-up on outstanding records.
